title.narrative: Sounds Right, Museum for the United Nations - UN Live

description.narrative: The objective of the project is to drive a significant improvement in the health of ecosystems in the identified landscapes (incl. in Africa) – across both biodiversity, climate and community impact variables – by accelerating Denmark’s public contribution to conservation and nature financing. The impact variables are (i) increase in hectares (land, ocean, water) protected and improved; and (ii) number of kilometres of rivers and streams protected and improved (deforestation averted), and (iii) number and diversity of species protected and improved - as well as (i) number of community-led activities supported, (ii) number of indigenous and local community members participating in and benefiting from livelihood programs; and (iii) number of land rights secured and enforced.
